Title: Valid credentials return a token
Expected Result: 200 and a non-empty token

Title: Wrong password is rejected
Steps: POST /auth with admin and a wrong password
Expected Result: No token returned; reason = Bad credentials

Title: Wrong username is rejected
Steps: POST /auth with an unknown user and the valid password
Expected Result: No token returned; reason = Bad credentials

Title: Empty username and password are rejected
Expected Result: No token returned; reason = Bad credentials

Title: Empty password is rejected
Steps: POST /auth with admin and an empty password
Expected Result: No token returned; reason = Bad credentials

Title: Create booking returns id and echoes data
Expected Result: 200; bookingid > 0; booking equals the request payload

Title: Create response is JSON and matches schema
Expected Result: Content-Type is application/json; body matches create_booking schema

Title: Created booking can be fetched
Expected Result: GET returns the same data that was created

Title: Create with varied valid data (4 data sets)
Steps: POST /booking with boundary prices (0, 1, 99999), special characters and both deposit values
Expected Result: 200; response echoes the input for each data set

Title: Missing mandatory fields are rejected
Expected Result: 4xx/5xx error status returned

Title: Non-JSON body is rejected
Steps: POST /booking with body 'this is not json'
Expected Result: 4xx/5xx error status returned

Title: Negative total price is rejected
Expected Result: Request rejected with a 400-level error (expected by good API design)

Title: Checkout before check-in is rejected
Steps: POST /booking with checkout date earlier than checkin date
Expected Result: Request rejected with a 400-level error (expected by good API design)

Title: Missing Accept header on PUT
Expected Result: Request handled normally or a clear 4xx error (not 418)

Title: Get all booking ids
Expected Result: 200; non-empty list of objects with bookingid

Title: Get by id matches schema
Expected Result: 200; body matches booking schema

Title: Non-existent id returns 404
Expected Result: 404 Not Found

Title: Filter by first and last name
Expected Result: 200; result contains the created booking id

Title: Single-request response time under threshold
Expected Result: Response time below configured threshold (10 s)

Title: Response headers present
Expected Result: Content-Type and Server headers present

Title: Filter by check-in and check-out dates
Expected Result: 200; result contains bookings within those dates

Title: PUT updates all fields
Steps: PUT /booking/{id} with new full payload and token cookie
Expected Result: 200; response equals the new payload

Title: PUT without token is forbidden
Expected Result: 403 Forbidden

Title: PUT with invalid token is forbidden
Expected Result: 403 Forbidden

Title: PATCH changes only supplied fields
Expected Result: 200; firstname changed; other fields unchanged

Title: PATCH without token is forbidden
Expected Result: 403 Forbidden

Title: PUT on non-existent id
Steps: PUT /booking/999999999 with valid payload and token
Expected Result: 404 (or other clear 4xx); no booking created

Title: DELETE removes the booking
Expected Result: Delete succeeds; subsequent GET returns 404

Title: DELETE without token is forbidden
Steps: DELETE /booking/{id} with no token; then GET
Expected Result: 403; booking still exists

Title: DELETE non-existent booking
Expected Result: 404 Not Found

Title: Delete the same booking twice
Expected Result: Second call returns 404

Title: Load test: 50 concurrent users
Steps: Run JMeter plan with users=50, rampup=30, loops=5
Expected Result: Error rate < 1%; 90th percentile response time < 2 s

Title: Load test: 100 concurrent users
Steps: Run JMeter plan with users=100, rampup=60, loops=5
